blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Dataset distillation (DD) aims to compress a large dataset into a small synthetic one that remains effective for training neural networks. Despite its success in supervised learning, DD remains underexplored in self-supervised learning (SSL), where distilled data must preserve the information needed to learn representations that remain consistent across augmentations. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mutual Information Prototype Alignment (MIPA), an efficient SSL dataset distillation approach that optimizes synthetic images to preserve augmentation-invariant information. Specifically, MIPA treats synthetic images as learnable prototypes and uses a frozen encoder to assign real samples to them based on feature similarity. A synthetic dataset that preserves such augmentation invariance should yield stable prototype assignments across multiple augmented views of the same real image. MIPA encourages this by maximizing mutual information between cross-view assignments while avoiding trivial solutions in which all real samples are assigned to only a few synthetic prototypes. Evaluations on image classification benchmarks show that synthetic data generated by MIPA yield higher-quality representations than existing distillation approaches while reducing time and storage demands during distillation.
blocks.zh: 数据集蒸馏(DD)旨在将一个大型数据集压缩成一个小型的合成数据集,这个数据集对于训练神经网络依然有效. 尽管在有监督的学习方面取得了成功,但DD在自我监督的学习(SSL)中仍然没有得到充分利用,在那里,提取的数据必须保存学习在各种扩展中始终一致的表述所需的信息。 为了弥合这一差距,我们采用了相互信息原型对齐(MIPA),这是一种高效的SSL数据集蒸馏方法,优化合成图像以保存增强-变异信息. 具体来说,MIPA将合成图像视为可学习的原型,并使用冷冻编码器根据特征相似性给它们分配真正的样品. 保存这种增量变化的合成数据集应产生稳定的原型任务,涵盖同一真实图像的多重增量观点。 MIPA鼓励这样做,在交叉查看任务之间尽量扩大相互信息,同时避免琐碎的解决办法,即所有真正的样品只分配给少数合成原型. 对图像分类基准的评价表明,MIPA生成的合成数据比现有的蒸馏方法能产生更高质量的表现,同时减少蒸馏过程中的时间和存储需求.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Dataset distillation (DD) seeks to condense a large dataset into a compact set of synthetic samples that approximate the effect of training on the full dataset while reducing memory and computational requirements [ 29 ] . This makes DD attractive for edge model training and continual learning, while its privacy implications have also received attention [ 36 , 27 , 4 , 8 ] . However, most existing DD methods focus on supervised settings that assume access to class labels, which are often scarce or unavailable in practice. In such cases, self-supervised learning (SSL) offers an alternative by pretraining an encoder on large amounts of unlabeled data, which can subsequently be adapted to a range of downstream tasks.
Accordingly, the computational and memory advantages of DD could also benefit SSL. Despite this potential, SSL-DD remains relatively underexplored.

数据集分馏(DD)试图将一个大数据集收缩成一组紧凑的合成样本,这些样本大致反映了培训对完整数据集的影响,同时减少了内存和计算要求[29]. 这使得DD对边缘模型培训和持续学习具有吸引力,而其隐私影响也受到了关注[36、27、4、8]。 然而,大多数现有的DD方法都侧重于假定访问类标签的有监督的设置,这些分类标签在实践中往往很少或没有. 在这种情况下,自我监督的学习(SSL)提供了一个替代方案,在大量无标签数据上预先培训编码器,随后可以适应一系列下游任务.
因此,DD的计算和内存优势也可以使SSL受益. 尽管有这种潜力,SSL-DD仍然相对未得到充分的开发.

blocks.en:
A compact synthetic dataset for SSL must preserve sufficient augmentation-invariant information from the original large-scale one to support learning useful representations with SSL.
Existing supervised DD methods, including gradient matching [ 35 , 33 ] , distribution matching [ 34 ] , and trajectory matching [ 4 ] , are not effective in this setting as their objectives rely on class-label supervision rather than the specific requirements of SSL.
More recently, KRR-ST [ 20 ] and MKDT [ 16 ] have attempted to bridge this gap by adapting supervised DD techniques
using auxiliary target representations as supervision signals
without fully accounting for the distinct learning objectives of SSL.
Consequently,
both methods require auxiliary target representations
alongside the synthetic images during SSL pretraining.
This dependence undermines the goal of standalone DD by increasing storage overhead,
requiring target-matching losses
instead of standard SSL objectives, and introducing potential security vulnerabilities associated with malicious teacher representations [ 5 ] .
Notably, we observe that removing these auxiliary representations and pretraining only on synthetic images does not reliably outperform randomly selecting real samples from the original dataset.

blocks.en:
In this work, rather than adapting supervised DD to SSL, we design an approach that directly accounts for the augmentation-invariance requirement of SSL.
To this end, we introduce M utual I nformation P rototype A lignment (MIPA), which treats synthetic images as learnable prototypes in the representation space.
In particular, for each real image, MIPA computes a probability distribution over these prototypes based on feature similarity, indicating the degree to which each synthetic image matches the real sample. It then evaluates these assignments over multiple views of the same image.
Preserving augmentation-invariant information in synthetic data should yield consistent assignments for different views of the same real image.
Simply minimizing distance-based objectives between assignments can result in trivial solutions in which all real images are assigned to the same limited subset of synthetic prototypes.
Instead, MIPA maximizes mutual information between cross-view assignments by optimizing the synthetic data, promoting consistency in assignments while avoiding such collapse, as demonstrated by our analysis and empirical results.
Figure 1(a) illustrates this procedure by showing assignment distributions from two views of the same real image.

blocks.en:
We evaluate MIPA on image classification benchmarks across multiple architectures and SSL methods. Our results indicate that MIPA yields higher-quality representations than prior distillation and sample selection approaches. More importantly, as shown in Figure 1(b) , MIPA achieves higher accuracy while significantly reducing the time and storage required during distillation.
In particular, we make the following contributions: 1. We identify augmentation consistency and prototype diversity as key to SSL distillation, demonstrating that consistency alone can lead to trivial solutions. 2. We propose MIPA, which maximizes mutual information between cross-view prototype assignments to enable SSL pretraining from scratch using only synthetic data. 3. Comprehensive experiments confirm MIPA’s effectiveness on downstream tasks while substantially reducing distillation time and storage requirements.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Dataset Distillation
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据集分解

blocks.en: Dataset distillation was first formulated as a bilevel optimization problem [ 29 ] . Subsequent approaches include gradient matching [ 35 ] , distribution matching [ 34 ] , kernel-based meta-learning [ 26 ] , and training trajectory matching [ 4 , 9 ] . Recent work further incorporates optimal transport into distribution-matching objectives [ 22 ] . Complementary studies investigate adversarial attacks [ 30 ] , privacy [ 36 ] , fairness [ 25 ] , and robustness to domain shifts [ 23 , 28 ] . Most of these methods operate in supervised settings. Other approaches leverage pretrained SSL encoders for data distillation under different assumptions. SC-DD [ 37 ] reconstructs images using batch-normalization statistics with class supervision, while LGM [ 3 ] learns labeled synthetic data by matching linear-classifier gradients on frozen SSL features. SRG [ 21 ] further utilizes class prototypes in SSL representation space to guide diffusion-based synthesis.
blocks.zh: 数据集分馏首先被制定为双层优化问题[29]. 随后的方法包括梯度匹配 [35],分布匹配 [34],以内核为基础的元学习 [26],以及训练轨迹匹配 [4,9]. 最近的工作进一步将最佳运输纳入配给目标[22]。 补充研究调查对抗性攻击[30],隐私[36],公平性[25],以及域位转移的稳健性[23,28]. 这些方法大多在有监督的环境下运作。 其他方法利用预先训练的SSL编码器进行不同假设下的数据分馏. SC-DD [37] 利用分批常态统计与分级监督重建图像,而LGM [3] 通过将被冻结的SSL特征上的线性分级梯度相匹配来学习被标记的合成数据. SRG [21] 进一步利用SSL代表空间中的类原型来指导以扩散为基础的合成.

blocks.en:
Self-supervised dataset distillation instead seeks to compress data without any class labels.
KRR-ST [ 20 ] adapts kernel-based matching to this setting. However, MKDT [ 16 ] reported that KRR-ST did not consistently outperform SSL pretraining on random real subsets and further showed that MTT [ 4 ] , although label-agnostic in principle, performs poorly when applied to SSL. MKDT instead replaces high-variance SSL trajectories with lower-variance knowledge-distillation trajectories. Yu et al. [31] further investigate SSL distillation by jointly optimizing synthetic images and target representations, using predefined augmentations and an approximation network to mitigate augmentation-related instability. Similar to KRR-ST and MKDT, this approach retains auxiliary representation targets for subsequent training. In contrast, MIPA uses a frozen SSL encoder solely to guide distillation, avoids inner-loop encoder training, and produces synthetic images that independently support SSL pretraining from scratch without class labels or auxiliary target representations.

Yu等 [31] 进一步通过联合优化合成图像和目标表示,利用预先定义的增强和近似网络来调查SSL分馏,以缓解与增强相关的不稳定. 与KRR-ST和MKDT类似,这种方法保留了后续培训的辅助代表目标. 相形之下,MIPA只使用被冷冻的SSL编码器来指导蒸馏,避免了内-loop编码器的训练,并生成独立支持SSL从零开始进行预训的合成图像,没有类标签或辅助目标表示.

blocks.en: 2.2 Self-Supervised Learning
blocks.zh: 2.2 自行监督学习

blocks.en:
Self-supervised learning aims to learn transferable representations from unlabeled data.
Contrastive methods such as SimCLR [ 6 ] and MoCo [ 12 ] align augmented views of the same image while separating representations of different images.
BYOL [ 10 ] and SimSiam [ 7 ] learn through prediction between views without explicit negative pairs. Barlow Twins [ 32 ] regularizes representation statistics by encouraging the cross-correlation matrix computed between two views toward the identity matrix.
Clustering-based methods such as SwAV [ 2 ] instead assign representations of augmented views to learnable prototypes and enforce consistency between their assignments across views.
Masked prediction techniques learn from partially observed inputs. For example, MAE [ 11 ] masks random patches of the input image and trains an encoder-decoder architecture to reconstruct the missing pixels. In contrast, I-JEPA [ 1 ] predicts the representations of target regions from a context region of the same image directly in feature space.
In this work, we focus primarily on SimCLR and conduct additional evaluations using Barlow Twins.
blocks.zh:
自我监督的学习旨在从无标签的数据中学习可转移的表示.
SimCLR [6] 和 MoCo [12] 等相矛盾的方法在分离不同图像的表示时,对同一图像的增强视图进行对接.
BYOL [10]和Simsiam [7]通过在没有明显的负对的视角间进行预测来学习. Barlow Twins[32]通过鼓励在两种观点之间计算出对身份矩阵的交叉关系矩阵来规范代表统计数据。
诸如SWAV[2]等基于集群的方法,相反地,为可学习的原型分配了扩增观点的表述,并强化了不同观点之间任务的一致性。
蒙面预测技术从部分观测到的投入中学习. 例如,MAE [11] 遮盖输入图像的随机补丁并训练出一个编码器-解码器架构来重建缺失的像素. 相形之下,I-JEPA[1]预测目标区域来自同一图像的上下文区域直接在地物空间的表示.
在这项工作中,我们主要侧重于SimCLR,并利用Barlow Twins进行更多的评价.

blocks.en:
Directly optimizing Eq. ( 2 ) is computationally expensive, as it requires repeatedly training an encoder on 𝒮 \mathcal{S} . To avoid this inner-loop training, we propose M utual I nformation P rototype A lignment (MIPA). The method uses a frozen encoder pretrained on 𝒯 \mathcal{T} to represent real and synthetic images in the same feature space. The synthetic images serve as prototypes , and each augmented real image is assigned to them based on feature similarity. These prototypes are then optimized by maximizing the mutual information between assignments from two augmented views of each real image.
Figure 2 illustrates the complete distillation process.

We evaluate MIPA on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 [ 18 ] , and Tiny ImageNet [ 19 ] , and conduct downstream evaluations on these datasets as well as FGVC Aircraft [ 24 ] and Stanford Dogs [ 17 ] .
We compare against three sample selection methods, Random , K-means , and SAS [ 15 ] , as well as two SSL-DD methods KRR-ST [ 20 ] and MKDT [ 16 ] . Random selects real training images uniformly at random, whereas K-means performs clustering over pretrained encoder embeddings of the full training set and then chooses real images closest to the resulting centroids. SAS also selects real samples based on their expected similarity to augmented views of other training examples, prioritizing those that are most beneficial for contrastive SSL. For KRR-ST and MKDT ,
we generate distilled sets using their official implementations.

blocks.en: For a consistent image-only comparison, we evaluate KRR-ST and MKDT using their synthetic images alone, excluding the auxiliary target representations required by their original procedures. This evaluates the standalone utility of the distilled images under a common from-scratch SSL protocol, rather than the performance of their complete training pipelines. We focus on this setting because the resulting datasets can be reused with standard SSL objectives without method-specific auxiliary targets. Methods that train a classifier on top of a frozen pretrained encoder (e.g., [ 37 , 3 ] ) address a different downstream setting and are not directly comparable here. We also report SSL results using the full training set as an upper-bound reference.
blocks.zh: 为了进行一致的仅以图像为主的比较,我们仅使用其合成图像来评价KRR-ST和MKDT,不包括其原始程序所要求的辅助目标表示. 这评价了蒸馏成像在从缝隙取出的共同SSL协议下的独立效用,而不是其完整的训练管的性能. 我们专注于这个设置,因为由此产生的数据集可以与标准的SSL目标重复使用,而无需特定方法的辅助目标. 在一个被冻结的事先训练的编码器上(例如[37,3])训练分类器的方法涉及不同的下游环境,在此不具有直接可比性。 我们还报告使用全套培训作为最高参考的SSL结果。

blocks.en:
We first pretrain a ResNet-18 [ 13 ] encoder with BatchNorm on the full unlabeled training set using SimCLR [ 6 ] for 1 ​ k 1k epochs and keep it frozen for the whole distillation process. Prototype assignments are then obtained from cosine similarities between embeddings produced by this frozen teacher from augmented views of real and synthetic images using a temperature τ \tau of 0.2 0.2 .
Unless otherwise noted, synthetic data are initialized by randomly sampling real images from the full dataset, and then optimized with Adam using a learning rate of 0.001 0.001 and a batch size ℬ \mathcal{B} of 128 128 .
We consider synthetic dataset sizes of 0.2 % 0.2\% , 1 % 1\% , and 2 % 2\% of the full training set and run MIPA for 10 ​ k 10k , 8 ​ k 8k , and 6 ​ k 6k iterations, respectively.
blocks.zh:
我们首先在使用SimCLR [6]的全无标签训练集上预装了ResNet-18 [13] 编码器,用于1k 1k个历程并保持其被冷冻,用于整个蒸馏过程. 原型任务则取自于这位被冷冻的老师用0.2的温度来放大真实和合成图像的视野而制作的嵌入相近的相通相。
除非另有说明,合成数据通过从整个数据集随机取样真实图像来初始化,然后用0.0010.001的学习率和128 128的批量大小 B\mathcal{B}与亚当进行优化.
我们认为,合成数据集的大小分别为0.2% . . . . . . . . 1% . . . 和2% . . . . . . . .

blocks.en: For each method and dataset budget, we train a ResNet-18 encoder from scratch using SimCLR on the resulting images alone. For KRR-ST and MKDT , this excludes the additional target representations required by their original downstream SSL procedures. We assess classification on the source dataset and transfer to downstream tasks through linear probing. In each case, we freeze the encoder and train a linear probe using either 1 % 1\% or 5 % 5\% from the labeled training data of the evaluation dataset, then measure accuracy on its test set. We repeat each evaluation over five independent runs and report the mean accuracy.
blocks.zh: 对于每一种方法和数据集预算,我们从零开始在生成的图像上使用SimCLR培训一个ResNet-18编码器。 就KRR-ST和MKDT而言,这不包括它们最初下游SSL程序所要求的额外目标表述。 我们通过线性探测来评估源数据集的分类和向下游任务的转移. 在每一种情况下,我们都会冻结编码器,并使用1%的1分之或5%的5分之之分从评价数据集的标签培训数据中训练出一线性探测器,然后在测试组中测量准确性。 我们重复了五次独立评估,并报告了平均准确性。

blocks.en: 5.2 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5.2 结果和讨论

blocks.en:
Table 1 shows that MIPA achieves the highest mean accuracy among reduced-data methods across all reported configurations, although some improvements over the strongest baselines are small relative to the reported variability.
Its improvements over the sample selection baselines suggest the benefit of optimizing synthetic images rather than selecting real samples. The gains are consistent on CIFAR-10 and become more pronounced on CIFAR-100 as the synthetic set size increases. At the 2 % 2\% CIFAR-100 setting, MIPA exceeds the strongest baseline, SAS , by 3.14 3.14 and 2.90 2.90 percentage points with 1 % 1\% and 5 % 5\% labeled data, respectively. Gains on Tiny ImageNet are smaller but remain consistent across the evaluated settings.
blocks.zh:
表1显示,在所有报告的配置中,MIPA在减少数据的方法中实现最高平均准确性,尽管相对于报告的可变性而言,相对于最强基线而言,一些改进不大。
它相对于样本选择基线的改进表明,优化合成图像而不是选择真实样本的好处。 这些收益在CIFAR-10上是一致的,在CIFAR-100上随着合成组尺寸的增大而变得更加明显. 在2%的CIFAR-100设定中,MIPA比最强的基准SAS分别高出3.14 3.14分和2.90 2.90分,其中1%为1%为1分,5%为5分。 小图像上的收益 网点较小,但在整个评价环境中保持稳定。

blocks.en:
MIPA also consistently benefits from larger synthetic datasets, whereas MKDT shows only marginal improvements or even declines in accuracy as the dataset size increases.
One possible explanation is that MKDT optimizes synthetic images to be used alongside teacher-derived representations, so increasing the synthetic budget does not necessarily improve their standalone utility when these targets are removed.
Both KRR-ST and MKDT generally underperform Random under our image-only evaluation protocol, with KRR-ST showing particularly large performance gaps on CIFAR-10. Importantly, both methods originally rely on auxiliary target representations alongside synthetic images for pretraining. Their lower performance in our setting therefore reflects the limitations of using their distilled images alone, rather than their complete training procedures. Overall, MIPA outperforms these methods using only synthetic images for SSL pretraining from scratch, although a gap to full-data pretraining still remains.
blocks.zh:
MIPA也始终受益于较大的合成数据集,而MKDT只显示随着数据集大小的增大而略有改进甚至精度下降.
一种可能的解释是,MKDT优化了合成图像,以便与师生的表达方式一起使用,因此,当这些目标被移除时,增加合成预算并不一定能提高它们的独立效用.
KRR-ST和MKDT在仅以图像为主的评价协议下一般都表现不佳,KRR-ST在CIFAR-10上表现出特别大的性能差距. 重要的是,这两种方法最初都依赖辅助目标表示以及合成图像进行预先训练。 因此,它们在我们环境中的较低性能反映了仅使用其蒸馏图像而不是完整的训练程序的局限性。 总体而言,MIPA的性能优于这些方法,只使用合成图像进行SSL从头到尾的预训,尽管与全数据预训仍有差距.

In this section, we evaluate how well models trained on synthetic datasets distilled by MIPA generalize when the downstream evaluation dataset differs from that used for SSL pretraining. Figure 3 illustrates the results.
As shown in the figure, MIPA matches or outperforms the other evaluated methods in every transfer setting among CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny ImageNet across different configurations.
Increasing the synthetic set size also consistently improves MIPA ’s downstream accuracy across all evaluated settings, indicating that the advantages of a larger distilled set generalize beyond classification on the source dataset.
Transfer to Aircraft and Dogs, however, is less stable, as MKDT or Random can outperform MIPA in some settings.
Overall, these results indicate that MIPA continues to perform well in downstream evaluations, although performance gaps between methods are often relatively minor.

在本节中,我们评价当下游评价数据集不同于SSL预训所用数据集时,由MIPA所分解的合成数据集培训的模型如何完善。 图3说明了结果。
如图所显示,MIPA在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny ImageNet的每一个传输设置中,在不同的配置中匹配或超过其他评估的方法。
增加合成装置的尺寸还不断提高MIPA在所有评价环境中的下游准确性,表明更大的蒸馏装置的优点超出源数据集的分类范围。
然而,向飞机和狗的转让不太稳定,因为有些情况下,MKDT或Random可以超过MIPA。
总体而言,这些结果表明,投资促进部在下游评价中继续表现良好,尽管方法之间的业绩差距往往相对较小。

blocks.en:
We evaluate whether the gains of MIPA persist when pretraining deeper networks than the one used to generate synthetic data.
We use ResNet-18 as the frozen encoder during distillation and the resulting synthetic data to pretrain ResNet-34 and ResNet-50 encoders.
Table 2 reports the results. MIPA outperforms Random on the source dataset in every evaluated setting, showing its gains extend to encoders different from the one used during distillation. Downstream accuracy also improves across all ResNet-50 and most ResNet-34 settings.
With ResNet-34, the larger CIFAR-10 synthetic set yields higher source-dataset accuracy but slightly lower downstream accuracy on CIFAR-100 and Tiny ImageNet. MIPA also performs slightly worse than Random when transferring from the smaller CIFAR-100 synthetic data to CIFAR-10.
Overall, MIPA maintains its benefits across architectures, with a few exceptions in downstream tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们评价,当预先培训比生成合成数据的网络更深的网络时,MIPA的收益是否继续存在。
我们使用ResNet-18作为蒸馏过程中被冻结的编码器,以及由此产生的合成数据来预排ResNet-34和ResNet-50编码器.

使用ResNet-34,更大的CIFAR-10合成集在CIFAR-100和Tiny ImageNet上产生更高的源数据集精度,但下游精度略低. 在将较小的CIFAR-100合成数据转移到CIFAR-10时,MIPA的性能也略逊于Random.
总的来说,投资促进局在各种结构中保持其优势,在下游任务中有一些例外。

We analyze how batch size and assignment temperature τ \tau in Eqs. ( 4 ) and ( 8 ) affect performance.
On CIFAR-10, we vary batch size using a 1 % 1\% synthetic set and assignment temperature using a 0.2 % 0.2\% synthetic set, keeping other settings fixed.
Figure 4 shows that MIPA outperforms Random in all evaluated settings.
However, increasing batch size does not necessarily improve performance. This may occur because averaging the joint assignment matrix P P over large batches smooths the empirical marginal distribution, weakening gradient signals from the marginal entropy term H P ​ ( C 1 ) H_{P}(C_{1}) that encourages diverse prototype usage.
Turning to the assignment temperature, the sweep shows that an intermediate value of τ = 0.2 \tau=0.2 performs best. Smaller temperatures produce overly sharp assignments, while larger temperatures make assignments more uniform across synthetic images. An intermediate temperature may therefore preserve distinctions between real images while avoiding excessive concentration on individual prototypes.

blocks.en: Random real-image initialization achieves the highest mean accuracy across all settings, with neither clustering method providing an advantage. One possible explanation is that clustering prioritizes representative samples based on feature-space structure, which may not necessarily align with the augmentation-invariant information targeted by MIPA . In contrast, random sampling provides diverse real-image structures without introducing clustering bias. Gaussian noise initialization performs substantially worse, even with 10 × 10\times more iterations. Although additional iterations partially improve performance, the gains are small and inconsistent, and accuracy remains below all real-image-based initializations. These findings suggest that real images provide useful initial structure that is difficult to recover from noise, while random sampling offers an effective initialization without additional clustering overhead.

blocks.en:
A key advantage of our method is its computational efficiency for distillation.
Table 6 compares the distillation runtime and disk storage requirements of MKDT and MIPA , excluding SSL teacher pretraining, which is required by our method and both MKDT and KRR-ST . All runtimes were measured on a single NVIDIA L40S GPU.
These measurements quantify distillation overhead rather than total end-to-end training cost. On CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, MIPA is approximately 5.8 5.8 – 8.0 × 8.0\times faster than MKDT , even before accounting for the additional cost of generating MKDT ’s expert trajectories. On Tiny ImageNet, MIPA remains faster, although the speedup decreases as the synthetic dataset size increases. Furthermore, by eliminating the need for expert trajectory buffers, MIPA reduces intermediate disk storage by more than 250 × 250\times across all three datasets, substantially lowering the resources required for distillation.

这些测量可以量化蒸馏管理费,而不是总的端到端培训费用。 在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上,MIPA大约比MKDT快5.8 — 8.0×8.0分,甚至在计算产生MKDT专家轨迹的额外费用之前。 在"Tiny ImageNet"上,MIPA保持了更快的速度,虽然随着合成数据集大小的增大,速度也在下降. 此外,由于不再需要专家的轨迹缓冲器,MIPA将所有三个数据集的中间磁盘存储量减少了250x250\次以上,从而大大降低了蒸馏所需的资源。

Figure 5 illustrates the synthetic images generated by MIPA using real-image initialization, alongside examples initialized from Gaussian noise. With real-image initialization, the optimized CIFAR-100 prototypes largely preserve the original object structures while showing noticeable changes in color, contrast, and texture. In contrast, the Gaussian-noise-initialized prototypes exhibit geometric patterns and local textures but little recognizable object structure.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduced MIPA , a self-supervised dataset distillation method that enables SSL pretraining from scratch using only synthetic images,
without requiring auxiliary target representations during SSL pretraining.
By maximizing mutual information between cross-view prototype assignments, MIPA produces compact synthetic datasets that outperform the evaluated image-only baselines while substantially reducing distillation time and storage requirements. Extensive evaluations on image classification and various downstream tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of MIPA across different model architectures, SSL methods, and synthetic dataset sizes.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们引入了MIPA,一种自我监督的数据集蒸馏方法,它使得SSL只能使用合成图像从头开始进行预训,
在SSL预训期间不需要辅助目标表示.
通过使交叉视图原型任务之间的相互信息最大化,MIPA制作的紧凑的合成数据集比评价的仅图像基线要好,同时大大减少了蒸馏时间和存储要求. 对图像分类和下游各项任务的广泛评价表明,MIPA在不同的模型结构、SSL方法和合成数据集尺寸方面是有效的。
